welcome.body:
🙏🏻 Welcome to *Whybee*! I create personalised content for you.

Here are some popular options — or browse the full catalog below 👇🏻
usecase.body: ✨ Amazing! Pick the style you'd love for your {productName} 👇🏻
confirm.nudge: 👆🏻 Tap one of the buttons above to continue.
confirm.editPrompt: ✏️ What would you like to change? Just tell me and I'll update it right away.
form.required: 📋 Please complete the form first, then we can continue!
form.photo.progress: 📸 Got it! ({current}/{max}) Send more photos or type *done* when ready.
form.photo.done: ✅ Perfect, that's all the photos we need!
form.photo.required: 📸 Please send at least one photo first.
form.photo.request: 📸 Now send your photos (1–3), then type *done* when you're ready.
fulfillment.payment: 🎉 Happy with your preview? Your final file — clean, crisp, and watermark-free — will arrive right here on WhatsApp the moment you pay.
fulfillment.delivering: 🎉 Thank you so much! Your file is on its way — we hope it's everything you imagined. Wishing you all the very best 💫
status.generating: ⏳ Still working on it, hang tight!
status.awaitingPayment: 💳 Please complete your payment using the link sent above.
errors.generic: 😔 Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.outputFailed: ⚠️ Something went wrong generating your file. Please contact support.
feedback.thanks: 💙 Thank you so much — your feedback truly means the world to us. We hope to create something special for you again soon 🌟
